options_liteModeNotice.message: Mode: Lite (Default) — ~6 MB store download (~22–25 MB on disk). Uses rule-based logic and Regex for fast behavior analysis with no network downloads.

options_privacyNoticeBody.message: Enabling Brain Upgrade initializes the bundled ONNX asyncify runtime (~22 MB unpacked, already in the package) and downloads DistilBERT weights (~67 MB once) from Hugging Face into your browser's IndexedDB. All page analysis is performed strictly on your device — your browsing data is processed locally and is never sent to external servers.

onboarding_welcomeSub.message: Your new context-aware AI browser companion is ready to go. Arcrawls lives in your browser, reacts to the pages you visit, and keeps you company while you work.

onboarding_canDoSub.message: Here's a quick look at your new browser pet's abilities.

onboarding_featureContextDesc.message: Reacts to HTTP status codes, page content, and your browsing behavior.

onboarding_featureAIDesc.message: Uses AI to analyze pages and respond with unique emotions and comments.

onboarding_featureXPDesc.message: Earn experience through interactions and watch Arcrawls level up over time.

onboarding_featurePersonalityDesc.message: Switch between Friendly, Sarcastic, Encouraging, Poetic, and Snarky.

onboarding_privacySub.message: Arcrawls runs 100% locally in your browser. Please review and accept our user data usage terms.

onboarding_privacy1.message: 100% Offline & Local: All text parsing, offline sentiment classification, and chat features run fully on your device.

onboarding_privacy2.message: Zero Data Selling: We do not track, store, or transmit your URLs, browsing history, or keystrokes to any external servers.

onboarding_privacy3.message: Narrowest Permissions: Permissions are restricted to local tab reactions, settings storage, and offline AI processing.

onboarding_consentLabel.message: I accept the terms and agree to run Arcrawls locally on web pages.

onboarding_allSetSub.message: Arcrawls is already roaming around your browser. Here are a few tips to get started:

onboarding_tip1.message: Pin the extension to your toolbar for quick access to the dashboard.

onboarding_tip2.message: Click the icon to view Arcrawls's stats, mood, and settings.

onboarding_tip3.message: Pet, feed, or shoo Arcrawls by interacting with him on any page.

onboarding_consentRequired.message: Please accept the privacy terms to proceed.

onboarding_updatedSub.message: Your context-aware AI browser companion has been updated to $1. Explore the new cross-tab behaviors and optimized performance!

onboarding_whatsNewSub.message: Version $1 brings significant architectural improvements and new features.

onboarding_featureToysDesc.message: Drop bouncy balls, laser pointers, and yarn directly onto the page. Arcrawls chases and plays with them using real-time spring physics!

onboarding_featureSynapseDesc.message: Arcrawls uses local AI to generate a unique, persona-driven daily reflection based on your browsing journey and habits over the last 24 hours.

onboarding_featureGhostDesc.message: Define Focus Blocks to suppress distractions, or use Ghost Mode which dynamically drops Arcrawls to 30% opacity when you type or scroll.

onboarding_featureMilestonesDesc.message: Track long-term achievements! Arcrawls now adapts his dominant personality trait (e.g. Gamer, Developer) based on the websites you visit.

onboarding_featureConsoleWatcherDesc.message: If a JavaScript runtime error or crashed promise occurs on the webpage, Arcrawls immediately enters "debugger" mode to alert you.

onboarding_featureUnifiedDesc.message: Personality, emotions, and physical location are flawlessly synchronized across all active tabs in real-time.

onboarding_featureGravityDesc.message: Arcrawls features a new physics engine restricting him exclusively to the floor and ceiling with smooth spring-based edge snapping.

onboarding_featureIntentDesc.message: Enhanced AI context awareness with high-fidelity intent detection for smarter, more relevant dialogue.

onboarding_featureRedesignDesc.message: Redesigned card-based stats grid and glassmorphic popup with new AI and tab status indicators.

onboarding_featureLiteModeDesc.message: Lite Mode uses Regex rules with no network downloads. The ~6 MB install includes bundled WASM; Brain Upgrade adds a one-time ~67 MB model fetch.

onboarding_featureBatteryDesc.message: Shifted to event-driven updates and lazy initialization for significantly better battery life.
